description: A Java class implementing an AMQP endpoint for managing device connection information within the Eclipse Hono framework. It handles incoming messages, constructs event bus requests, and manages response messaging related to device connection API operations.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: A class that extends RequestResponseEndpoint to handle AMQP messages for device connection management in Hono. It processes incoming requests, creates event bus messages, verifying message format, and returning appropriate AMQP responses.

methods.name: DeviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint with a Vertx instance.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this endpoint.

methods.name: getEventBusServiceAddress
methods.description: Provides the specific address on the event bus to which messages are sent.

methods.name: createEventBusRequestMessage
methods.description: Builds an EventBusMessage from the incoming AMQP message, including tenant and device identifiers, or fails if JSON decoding is malformed.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Verifies if the incoming message meets certain criteria defined by DeviceConnectionMessageFilter.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Creates an AMQP reply message based on the EventBusMessage.
